### P2 "ImageToPoints.1" (Compute Shader) · Compute

description: Point cloud from image brightness. The image is sampled on a grid of about vertex-count points with the image's aspect ratio; pixels whose luminance (Rec. 601, times alpha, so transparent areas stay empty) exceeds threshold become points, pushed toward +Z by brightness x zScale. pointScale sets the cloud size (X is multiplied by the aspect ratio). Colour is the pixel colour, or its luminance in G…; categories: Geometry Generator; resources: geo:geometry, inputTexture:texture, threshold:float, zScale:float, pointScale:point3D, colorMode:long

```glsl
void main()
{
    uint idx = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x;
    uint count = uint(ISF_WRITE(geo, position).length());
    if(idx >= count)
        return;

    // Grid with the image's own aspect ratio, so the cloud is not stretched.
    ivec2 texSize = textureSize(inputTexture, 0);
    float aspect = float(max(texSize.x, 1)) / float(max(texSize.y, 1));
    uint gridW = uint(sqrt(float(count) * aspect));
    if(gridW < 1u) gridW = 1u;
    uint gridH = count / gridW;
    if(gridH < 1u) gridH = 1u;

    uint gx = idx % gridW;
    uint gy = idx / gridW;
```

### P4 "RGB Simplex Noise" (ISF Shader) · Fragment

description: generates a basic simplex noise; categories: Noise, Utility; inputs: offset:point2D=[0,0], scale:float=4

```glsl
// https://gist.github.com/patriciogonzalezvivo/670c22f3966e662d2f83
// Simplex 2D noise
//
vec3 permute(vec3 x) { return mod(((x*34.0)+1.0)*x, 289.0); }

float snoise(vec2 v){
  const vec4 C = vec4(0.211324865405187, 0.366025403784439,
           -0.577350269189626, 0.024390243902439);
  vec2 i  = floor(v + dot(v, C.yy) );
  vec2 x0 = v -   i + dot(i, C.xx);
  vec2 i1;
  i1 = (x0.x > x0.y) ? vec2(1.0, 0.0) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);
  vec4 x12 = x0.xyxy + C.xxzz;
  x12.xy -= i1;
  i = mod(i, 289.0);
  vec3 p = permute( permute( i.y + vec3(0.0, i1.y, 1.0 ))
  + i.x + vec3(0.0, i1.x, 1.0 ));
  vec3 m = max(0.5 - vec3(dot(x0,x0), dot(x12.xy,x12.xy),
    dot(x12.zw,x12.zw)), 0.0);
  m = m*m ;
  m = m*m ;
  vec3 x = 2.0 * fract(p * C.www) - 1.0;
  vec3 h = abs(x) - 0.5;
  vec3 ox = floor(x + 0.5);
  vec3 a0 = x - ox;
  m *= 1.79284291400159 - 0.85373472095314 * ( a0*a0 + h*h );
  vec3 g;
  g.x  = a0.x  * x0.x  + h.x  * x0.y;
  g.yz = a0.yz * x12.xz + h.yz * x12.yw;
  return 130.0 * dot(m, g);
}

void main()	{
    vec2 uv = isf_FragNormCoord.xy + offset;
	gl_FragColor = vec4(snoise(uv * scale), snoise(uv * scale - vec2(1)), snoise(uv * scale + vec2(1)), 1.0);
}
```
